head.title: Calibration runs
head.subtitle: Which measurement run each grade's parent reports read, how it went, and re-running it when needed.

model.title: How measurement works
model.jobs: Measurement runs only as a background job. A run starts on its own when a wave closes; you can also re-run it by hand.
model.own: Each run writes its own rows and never overwrites another run. Older runs stay saved.
model.current: Exactly one run per grade is current. Parent reports read only the current run, so switching it changes every report of that grade at once.
model.v0: v0 (raw_band_v0): the score is the number of correct scored items on the wave form. Pretest items do not count.
model.band: A band is the percentile of the score ± SEM within region × grade × season. Below 30 children in a cohort no band is shown — the parent reads "not enough children in this cohort yet".
model.young: Grades 0–2 get skill states only (secure, emerging, not yet), never a rank or a band.
model.v1: v1 (rasch_anchor_equating_v1): θ from a Rasch model, the band is θ ± 1.0 SE. Anchor items are held at the earlier v1 values, so seasons stay on one scale. A v1 run is not shown to parents until you make it current.

toolbar.v1Bands: The band is θ ± 1.0 SE (Rasch, JMLE).
toolbar.v1Anchors: Anchor items are held at the difficulty of the earlier v1 run (a first v1 run has no anchors).
toolbar.v1Inflation: Inflation measured by the in-person final is taken off per region — when there are at least 30 pairs.
toolbar.v1NotCurrent: A v1 run does not become current: parents won't see it until you press "Make current".

grade.emptyTitle: No runs for this grade yet
grade.emptyBody: A run starts automatically when a wave of this grade closes. Nothing to do until then.
grade.noCurrent: No run of this grade is current yet, so its parent reports have nothing to read. Make one of the runs below current.

run.wavesNote: Staff only — parents never see these numbers.
run.noWaves: No wave was measured in this run.

v1.title: Rasch v1
v1.firstRun: This is the first v1 run: there were no earlier anchor values to hold.
v1.noInflation: No region has had a final yet.

history.dlgBodyFmt: The grade {g} parent reports will switch to the run from {d} at once. The run that is current now stays saved, and you can switch back at any time.
history.doneFmt: Grade {g}: the run from {d} is now current.
history.dlgBodyV1: This is a v1 run: parents will read its Rasch bands.

rerun.dlgBody: A new run is written next to the old ones and becomes current when it finishes, so the parent reports then read it. Older runs are kept, and you can switch back.
rerun.dlgBodyAll: Every grade that has a closed wave this season gets a new run.
rerun.doneFmt: New runs started: {n}. They are now current.
rerun.none: Nothing to measure: no wave has closed yet for this choice.

runV1.dlgBody: A new Rasch run is written next to the old ones but does not become current — the parent reports keep reading the run they read now. Compare the result with the current run, then make it current if you want.
runV1.dlgBodyAll: Every grade that has a closed wave this season gets a new v1 run.
runV1.doneFmt: New v1 runs: {n}. They are not current — compare them and make one current if needed.
runV1.none: Nothing to measure: no wave has closed yet for this choice.

compare.title: Compare runs
compare.sub: Pick two runs of one grade — usually the current run and the newest other one. Counts only: no child is named.
compare.needTwo: Comparing needs at least two finished runs of one grade.
compare.privacy: Counts only — no child is named.
compare.noWaves: No wave is present in both runs.
compare.itemsTitle: The 15 items whose difficulty moved most
compare.noItems: Item difficulties were not written in a way that can be compared.
compare.noInflation: Neither run applied an inflation adjustment.
compare.errNotComparable: These runs belong to different grades or seasons, so they can't be compared.
compare.errNotFound: One of the runs was not found. Pick another from the list.

items.title: Item statistics
items.body: p, point-biserial, dead distractors and DIF uz/ru in the item bank now come from the current run of each grade.

errors.METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE: This method is not available right now.
errors.NO_SEASON: There is no current season, so there is nothing to measure.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That run no longer exists or has not finished yet. The page has been refreshed.
errors.NETWORK: No connection. Check the network and try again.

states.noAccessBody: Calibration runs belong to the bank editor. If you need them, ask a super admin for that role.
states.errBody: The server did not answer. Your runs are safe — try again in a moment.
